Tuning llama.cpp threads on Ryzen

Thread count matters more than most people expect when running quantized models on a desktop processor. Setting threads to the number of physical cores is usually the best starting point.

Measure before changing

Record prompt processing and generation speed with the default settings, then change one value at a time and record again.

  • Use physical cores, not logical threads.
  • Keep the batch size fixed while testing.
llama-server -m model.gguf -t 8 -b 512
ThreadsTokens per second
841.2
1637.9
